name: Thundering Hearts
summary: In Thousand Needles, the researcher seeks Stormheart’s massive heart for work on an abomination.

sections.title: A Large Heart
sections.body: A researcher studying abomination creation believes the work calls for a massive heart. Stormheart, a thunder lizard said to patrol the canyon edge in Thousand Needles, seems large enough. But Stormheart is not docile.

sections.title: The Heart
sections.body: Stormheart’s heart still carries electrical pulses. The researcher says it appears to match the size specified in the notes and will be added to the abomination.

faq.answer: A researcher studying abomination creation wants Stormheart’s heart for an abomination.
Stormheart patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles.
Stormheart is a thunder lizard of impressive size.
The researcher’s notes say abomination creation requires a massive heart.

faq.q: What does the researcher know about the heart?
faq.answer: The researcher says the heart still carries electrical pulses and appears to match the size specified in the notes.
